sites.notes:
I read origin/main at 80143cd0 after a fresh `git fetch`. I made no writes and ran no tests or checks. Every enforcement claim below rests on quoted check code, not on running the check.

**Checks that actually fail today for GitHub-tracked work:**
1. `tools/workspace.py` rejects any issue id that is not `kel-<n>`, so `just work-start gh-520 …` exits with "Invalid issue".
2. `tools/session_closeout.py` accepts a tracked finding only as `KEL-n` plus a linear.app URL. A GitHub-tracked finding is rejected, and the Codex closeout hook then blocks the session.
3. `tools/product_status.rs` accepts only `KEL-` ids in the ledger's issues column.

**Coupled edit you must not miss:** changing workspace.py or session_closeout.py changes their SHA-256 hashes, which are pinned in `.codex/hooks.json`. You must regenerate hooks.json in the same PR; otherwise `tools/test_session_closeout_hook.py` fails in CI and the live Codex hook fails closed.

**Wording that is locked by checks:**
- `tools/ci_hygiene.rs` requires the PR template to contain the text `agent/kel-`, so extend that branch line rather than replace it.
- `tools/atomic_protocol.rs` pins coordination.md:40-41 ("…relevant Linear decision, OS handoff, or branch handoff.") and workflow.md:12-13 ("…internal Linear linkage…") word for word. It also requires the step-1 atom sentences to appear exactly once, so a GitHub copy of step 1 would fail.

**Nothing in GitHub CI checks branch names, PR titles or PR bodies for KEL ids.** KeldBot only checks the six PR headings and the conventional title format, and ci.yml has no head_ref check.

**Byte budgets** (current size / budget from `.agents/instruction-budget.tsv`, then free bytes):

| File | Size / budget | Free | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| AGENTS.md | 13305/13312 | 7 | always; ROOT_MAX 16384; whole always chain capped at 24 KiB |
| docs/agents/workflow.md | 16353/16384 | 31 | budget already equals the hard 16 KiB cap, so additions must be offset by trims |
| .agents/index.md | 4056/4096 | 40 | hard cap 4096 |
| .agents/coordination.md | 4297/4352 | 55 | |
| .agents/instructions.md | 3062/3072 | 10 | |
| .agents/research.md | 6095/6144 | 49 | |
| .agents/ci.md | 3936/4096 | 160 | |
| .agents/review.md | 1907/2304 | 397 | |
| .agents/memory.md | 6622/7168 | 546 | |
| docs/agents/spec-template.md | 2732/3072 | 340 | |

The development guide and architecture 01 are not budgeted. Architecture 01 and the generated product-status.md are in the llms corpus, so editing either needs `just llms-check`.

**Order and process:**
- Recommended order: first the one #517 owner rule in coordination.md, including the GitHub status mapping (open+unassigned=Todo, self-assigned+claim=In Progress, `blocked` label=Blocked, closed=Done); then the workflow.md, AGENTS.md, review.md and index.md wording; then workspace.py and session_closeout.py plus the hooks.json regeneration, under a separate tooling review.
- `.agents/instructions.md` itself requires "named Linear scope" for budget changes. Either run #520 under its covering Linear issue (KEL-124) or fix that line first.
- The instruction-file edits need `just agent-context`, `just atomic-protocol`, `just hygiene`, and an instruction-review per root AGENTS.md.

**Could not inspect:**
- `.coderabbit.yaml`, `hooks/`, `.claude/**` and labeler configs are not in origin/main.
- The local `.claude/settings.local.json` has no hooks, only permissions.
- I did not check the private Prompt Tracker (`prompts/SHARED/branch-linear-handoff.md`), the `docs/research` checkout, live Linear or GitHub state, or locally generated Cursor/Claude hook registrations on other machines.
- I only grepped `learnings.md`. It has 3 Linear mentions; l.121 repeats `agent/kel-<n>-<slug>`, which is evidence only.
- Nested crate AGENTS.md files and ci.yml step names cite KEL issues only as history; those are cosmetic and need no change.
